---
title: "Map"
---

This is a working map of sites in County Dublin linked to the Catholic Church: churches, convents, presbyteries and religious houses, Catholic-ethos schools, and institutions run by religious orders. It is built from open data, including OpenStreetMap, the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage, the four Dublin councils' Records of Protected Structures, the Department of Education school lists and the official reports on residential institutions. For the full method and every source, see [Method](method.qmd).

Each point shows where a site is, not who owns it. Ownership is confirmed site by site against Land Registry folios, so for now every point is a lead (grade D on the [evidence scale](method.qmd#confidence-grades)), apart from properties the State records as handed over by the orders, which are former holdings (grade E).
